PLAN "Upper Body Strength - Right Subacromial Impingement Rehab-Informed"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build pain-free upper-body strength with shoulder-safe loading"
  GOAL secondary resilience:
    name "Improve rotator cuff and scapular control for climbing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper A - Foundation":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          external_rotation 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          cat_cow 60 seconds
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper B - Foundation":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          prone_T 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          back_stretch 60 seconds
